findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done — `team.sentence` is set to the go-live clause alone. The required team summary is absent, so consumers cannot show the summary sentence with its go-live clause. The pace test checks the clause but does not catch this gap.
findings.title: Not done: join the go-live clause into the team sentence

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Functional — the set groups PRs by display name and the weekly filter uses that name again. In a team with two authors who share a GitHub name, their PRs appear as one person's weekly counts, contrary to the per-person trend requirement.
findings.title: People with the same GitHub name are merged into one trend row

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 4, Harm 2
The branch supplies the JSON trends here, but the page does not yet draw the six weekly marks, per-person rows or adjacent around-Forge list. The story's Tasks table assigns that page and its browser proof to RUNWAY.
findings.title: Later: RUNWAY renders the trends and around-Forge list
